common.name: Name

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.transfersMoneyNote: Sales at a price between stores — current
dashboard.fixedNote: These numbers are current and not affected by the period
dashboard.periodNote: The numbers and charts below change with the selected period
dashboard.copyEmpty: No in-stock products to copy in this store
dashboard.expensesDeductedSub: {{amount}} of it is deducted from profit

items.title: Products
items.noCategories: There are no categories. Add a category first from the Categories page.
items.archiveNote: If the product is used in invoices it will be hidden (archived) and your old invoices stay as they are. If it has stock, it is removed from total stock and capital.

stockCount.title: Stock count
stockCount.heading: Stock count — {{name}}
stockCount.empty: No products in stock in this store

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.newProductHint: New product: set its category and it will be added to Products automatically
purchases.deleteNote: The quantities will be removed from stock (rejected if some were sold).
purchases.paidByPartner: {{name}} paid it from their own pocket (the partnership owes them this amount)
purchases.deletePaymentsWarning: Recorded supplier payments ({{amount}}) will be deleted with it
purchases.paidByBoth: They paid out of pocket (each by their share)

sales.title: Sales
sales.foreignNote: Products from another store are transferred automatically (sale at the transfer price) on save, and marked paid once the invoice is fully paid.
sales.shopPaysNote: Shop pays shipping: {{amount}} — an expense deducted from profit, not added to the customer invoice
sales.customerPlaceholder: Pick a customer or type a new name
sales.deleteNote: The quantities will go back to stock.
sales.deletePaymentsWarning: Recorded payments ({{amount}}) will be deleted with it
sales.foreignToggle: Add products from {{name}} to this invoice
sales.foreignLocked: The invoice has products from the other store: remove them first to turn this off

returns.title: Returns
returns.toSourceNote: Unchecked: the piece returns to the invoice’s store. Checked: it returns to the store it came from, and what’s owed to that store goes down.
returns.pickLines: Set the returned quantity for each product
returns.deleteNote: Deleting a return reverses its effect on stock (rejected if the pieces were sold).
returns.refundHint: The customer is owed {{amount}} on this invoice: whatever isn’t refunded in cash stays as their credit, deducted from their next invoice.
returns.refundCashOnly: Invoice without a customer: all the money ({{amount}}) is refunded in cash.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changePathNote: The database will be moved to the new location and the app will restart.
settings.confirmImport: Current data will be replaced by the imported copy (a safety copy is saved automatically) and the app will restart. Continue?
settings.appNameNote: Shown in the sidebar, login screen, splash screen and window title. Leave it empty to use the default name.

errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS: Return quantity exceeds what can be returned from this invoice
errors.IN_USE: Cannot delete because it is used by other data
errors.INVALID_BACKUP_FILE: The selected file is not a valid backup
errors.TARGET_EXISTS: A database file already exists in the selected location
errors.DUPLICATE_NAME: An item with the same name already exists
errors.HAS_RETURNS: It has returns, delete the return first
errors.PAID_EXCEEDS_TOTAL: Paid amount is more than the invoice total
errors.CUSTOMER_REQUIRED: Pick a customer to record the remaining amount on
errors.TOTAL_BELOW_PAID: The new total is less than the amount already paid
errors.PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_REMAINING: The amount is more than the remaining
errors.OWNER_REQUIRED: Set the main store owner first (on the Partnerships page) so products from the other store are transferred in their name
errors.RETURN_EXCEEDS_SOURCE: The quantity is more than the pieces from the other store in this invoice
errors.TRANSFER_FROM_SALE: This transfer belongs to a sale invoice: edit or delete it from the invoice
errors.NOT_A_SALE_TRANSFER: Payments can only be recorded on “sale at price” transfers
errors.TRANSFER_HAS_PAYMENTS: This transfer has payments: its type, partner and direction can’t change. Delete the payments from partner accounts first.
errors.OWNER_NOT_PARTNER: The main store owner must be one of the two partners
errors.DUPLICATE_PARTNERS: The two partners must be different
errors.WORKSPACE_CLOSED: This partnership is closed — reopen it first
errors.PERSONAL_WORKSPACE: Your own stock can’t be edited, closed or deleted
errors.WORKSPACE_NOT_EMPTY: This partnership has data — close it instead of deleting
errors.INVALID_TRANSFER: A transfer must be between the personal stock and a partnership
errors.PARTNER_NOT_FOUND: That partner is not in this partnership
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The password must be at least 8 characters
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts, wait a bit and try again
errors.NOT_SETUP: No password has been set yet
errors.PASSWORD_MISMATCH: The two passwords do not match
errors.BACKUP_KEY_MISMATCH: This backup belongs to a different installation and cannot be opened here
errors.AUTO_BACKUP_FAILED: Automatic backup failed. Make sure the folder exists (or the drive is connected) and has free space
errors.NOT_WAREHOUSE: This page is for external warehouses only. Switch to one from the sidebar.
errors.PARTNER_INVOICE_PAID: The partner already paid part of this transfer’s invoice: delete those payments from their statement in the main store first
errors.SALE_FROM_TRANSFER: This invoice was created by a transfer to a partner: edit or delete it from the Transfers page
errors.REFUND_EXCEEDS: The refunded amount is more than the customer’s money on this invoice
errors.PAID_BY_PARTNER: A partner paid this invoice out of pocket; it has no supplier payments
errors.NAME_TOO_LONG: The name is too long (40 characters max)

details.adjustmentsNote: Opening quantities or manual adjustments not recorded as movements: new {{new}} / damaged {{damaged}}

invoice.toAccount: Credited to the customer (off their balance or as credit)

toast.archived: The product was hidden because it is used in invoices

customers.title: Customers
customers.collectOldestFirst: The amount is applied to the customer's oldest invoices first
customers.deletePaymentNote: The payment will be deleted and the invoice remaining will increase.
customers.creditSub: Overpaid after returns — deducted from their invoices
customers.rangeNote: Totals count only invoices in this period, and only customers with invoices in it are shown.

workspaces.title: Stores & partnerships
workspaces.ownerHint: Added as a partner in every new partnership. Renaming them renames them in all their partnerships.
workspaces.ownerMissing: Set the main store owner so they’re added automatically as a partner in new partnerships.
workspaces.ownerFixed: Main store owner — change it from the “Main store” row
workspaces.yourNameHint: Saved as the main store owner and added automatically to new partnerships
workspaces.name: Partnership name (optional)
workspaces.nameHint: e.g. Perfume project — tells apart two partnerships with the same person
workspaces.passwordPrompt: Enter the app password to confirm
workspaces.closeNote: A closed partnership leaves the switcher but its data stays saved. Only an empty partnership can be deleted.
workspaces.deleteNote: Only an empty partnership is deleted. One with data is closed instead.
workspaces.warehouseNote: An external warehouse holds quantities and shipments only (no prices or sales). Pick it from the store switcher like any store.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.fromSaleNote: This transfer is edited and deleted with the sale invoice, but you pay it yourself here (it is not paid automatically with the invoice).
transfers.paymentNote: The payment is recorded as a partner settlement in partner accounts.
transfers.deletePaymentsWarning: This transfer has {{amount}} in payments, which will be deleted with it.
transfers.editNote: Saving returns the old pieces to the store they came from and redoes the transfer with the new data. If the other store already sold some pieces, the new quantity can’t be less than what was sold.
transfers.noPartnership: No open partnership. Create one from "Stores & partnerships" first.
transfers.deleteNote: Deleting a transfer returns the pieces to the store they left (rejected if the other store already sold or used them).

kindHint.capital: Pieces count as the partner's capital at their cost (not a sale).
kindHint.sale: A price per piece is agreed: it becomes owed to (or by) the partner and sets the other store's cost.
kindHint.half: Moved with no partner accounting: pieces carry over at cost only.

recipientHint.owner: For {{owner}}: capital (returned at liquidation) or sale at a price (the partnership owes them the price).
recipientHint.partner: {{partner}} buys the pieces from {{owner}}: they count as {{partner}}’s capital at the piece price, and a sale invoice for the same price is recorded on them in the main store ({{owner}} keeps the profit).
recipientHint.partnership: The pieces join the partnership’s products at cost: the partnership owes {{owner}} the cost, so each partner bears half, and the sale profit is split.

transfers.unpayNote: All payments on this transfer will be deleted and it goes back to unpaid (their partner settlements are deleted too).
transfers.removePaymentNote: The amount goes back to the transfer remaining (its partner settlement is deleted).

warehouse.note: Quantities and shipments, amounts in SAR. When a shipment arrives, record it as a purchase in the store that received it.
warehouse.arrivedNote: Don't forget to record this shipment as a purchase in the store that received it
warehouse.deleteShipmentNote: Quantities go back to the warehouse.
warehouse.perPieceNote: Amounts are per piece in SAR. Cost per piece = price + shipping + customs; total = quantity × cost per piece.

partners.title: Partner accounts
partners.storeNote: What a partner takes from the main store for themselves is recorded as a sale in the main store to their customer (same name), and their payments are collected from the Customers page.
partners.formula: Remaining = profit share + own goods sold to the partnership + paid from own pocket − actually paid. Capital is shown separately and returned at liquidation. Hover the ⓘ next to any column name for an explanation.
partners.personalNote: Partner accounts live inside partnerships. Switch to a partnership from the sidebar.
partners.salesTitle: Sale invoices each partner made to customers
partners.capitalHint: Goods they put in as capital, at cost. Not part of “Remaining”; returned to them when the partnership is liquidated.
partners.soldHint: Their own goods sold to the partnership at a price (“sale at price” transfers from their store, and their products sold in partnership invoices). The partnership owes them this.
partners.profitShareHint: Their half (50%) of the partnership’s actual profit.
partners.settledHint: Money actually paid between the partnership and the partner: settlements and “sale at price” transfer payments.
partners.balanceHint: Remaining = profit share + sold to the partnership + paid from own pocket − actually paid. “to them” = the partnership still owes them; “they owe” = they owe the partnership.
partners.storeAccountHint: What they took for themselves from the main store through sale invoices and haven’t paid yet. Separate from the partnership account.
partners.paidOutHint: Money they put in from their own pocket: partnership purchases they paid (after returns), plus what they paid their partner in a “settlement between partners” (what they received from their partner is subtracted). The partnership owes them this.
partners.salesNote: This is the partnership’s money (part of its profit, split equally), not a debt to anyone.
partners.transferNote: This money was paid between the partners outside the partnership’s money: what {{to}} is owed goes down, and what {{from}} is owed goes up by the same amount.

statement.title: {{name}} — statement
statement.shareHow: Partnership actual profit {{actual}} − expenses {{expenses}} = net profit {{net}}; their share is {{percent}}%
statement.balanceOwed: The partnership still owes {{name}} {{amount}} (capital not included)
statement.capitalNote: Capital is returned separately on liquidation, so their total on liquidation = capital + balance = {{total}}
statement.movements: Movements behind each item (click an item to open it)
statement.settledNote: Positive = the partnership paid them, negative = they paid the partnership. Partner-to-partner settlements appear under “paid out of pocket”.

auth.setupSubtitle: You will need it every time you open the app
auth.setupNote: At least {{min}} characters. If you forget it you will need the recovery key shown after this step.
auth.recoverySubtitle: This is the only way to open your data if you forget the password
auth.recoveryWarning: This key is shown only once. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this computer. Anyone with the key can open your data.
auth.recoverySaved: I saved the key somewhere safe
auth.lockedSubtitle: Enter your password to open your data
auth.wait: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.
auth.recoverSubtitle: Enter your recovery key and choose a new password
auth.securityNote: Your data is protected by your password. The app locks itself when idle.
auth.newRecoveryKeyNote: This invalidates the old key. Use it if you lost the original or it was exposed.
auth.restoreSubtitle: On a new device or after reinstalling
auth.restoreNote: Pick the backup file. The second file created with it at export time must be in the same folder, and the password is the one from when it was exported.

autoBackup.title: Automatic backup
autoBackup.note: A full backup every day when you open the app (and hourly while it is open, once a day has passed).
autoBackup.defaultFolderWarning: Backups are on this same computer and will be lost if the disk fails. Pick a folder on a USB drive, an external disk, or a Google Drive / OneDrive folder.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.categoryHint: Pick a type or type a new one
expenses.deductHint: Deducted from net profit on the dashboard (and from partner shares in a partnership).
expenses.recordOnlyHint: Record only: shown in expenses, does not affect profit.
expenses.noTypes: No types yet. Type a new one
